lead.headline: Companies late on stock-option award reports in 2017-20 stayed late in 2021-24: roughly 13% vs 1.5% for peers
lead.number: Builder: 20.3% of 2021-24 awards 30+ days late at the 23 repeat companies vs 1.5% at 1,248 peers; skeptic's rough cut without Security National is about 13% (not re-run). AgEagle: 85 of 117 awards 30+ days late.
lead.watch_out: The #1 contributor, Security National, is a stock-dividend re-report artifact; AgEagle's 2021-24 lates sit on catch-up filing days; "option awards" also counts warrants, convertible preferred and RSUs.
